```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(cars, aes(x = speed, y = dist)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Cars Data",
    x = "Speed (mph)",
    y = "Stopping distance (ft)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
